name: crypto-mines
description: CRYPTO MINES — Stake Engine instant game

scripts.build: npm run build -w @crypto-mines/shared && npm run build -w @crypto-mines/math-engine && npm run build -w @crypto-mines/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @crypto-mines/shared && npm run test -w @crypto-mines/math-engine && npm run test -w @crypto-mines/rgs-mock && npm run test -w @crypto-mines/frontend
scripts.signoff:math: npm run build -w @crypto-mines/shared && npm run build -w @crypto-mines/math-engine && node scripts/run-phase5-signoff.mjs
scripts.signoff:phase5c: npm run build -w @crypto-mines/shared && npm run build -w @crypto-mines/math-engine && node packages/math-engine/dist/cli/phase5c-signoff.js && node scripts/write-math-complete-ladder.mjs && node scripts/phase5c-book-reconciliation.mjs
scripts.signoff:phase5d: npm run build -w @crypto-mines/shared && npm run build -w @crypto-mines/math-engine && node packages/math-engine/dist/cli/phase5d-signoff.js && node scripts/write-math-complete-ladder.mjs && npm run generate:books
scripts.generate:books: npm run build -w @crypto-mines/shared && npm run build -w @crypto-mines/math-engine && node scripts/generate-books.mjs
